title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Finland – EGF/2026/003 FI/Valmet Automotive
part_text: 9. Notes with concern that Finland started providing the measures on 23 March 2026, approximately six weeks before submitting its application to the EGF and several months before the mobilisation decision; considers that such retrospective reimbursement risks turning the EGF into a refinancing mechanism for national labour-market measures that have already been decided and implemented;
